news.title: NTR Graces Pre-Release Event of Fahadh Faasil's Direct Telugu Debut
news.summary: Actor NTR attended the pre-release gathering of Fahadh Faasil's upcoming direct Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble as the chief guest. Directed by Sashank Yeleti, the movie is scheduled to release on October 2. NTR praised Fahadh's acting prowess and expressed strong support for producer S.S. Karthikeya.

news.title: Expectations High for Family Entertainer Don't Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Sashank Yeleti's upcoming directorial Don't Trouble The Trouble starring Fahadh Faasil is gearing up for an October 2 release. Promoted as a wholesome family entertainer with emotional depth, the film is expected to attract family audiences and kids during the long weekend. S.S. Rajamouli has also endorsed the project, which marks Karthikeya's debut as a producer.

news.title: NTR's Special Appearance Amplifies Hype for DTTT
news.summary: NTR's enthusiastic participation as the chief guest at the pre-release event of Don't Trouble The Trouble brought immense spotlight to the project. He delivered an emotional speech highlighting his deep bond with producer S.S. Karthikeya and praised lead actor Fahadh Faasil. The film, directed by Sashank Yeleti, hits the big screens on October 2nd.

news.title: Early Buzz Surrounds Naga Chaitanya's Silver Jubilee Project
news.summary: Naga Chaitanya is currently busy filming Vrushakarma under Karthik Dandu's direction, slated for a December 4 release with Meenakshi Chaudhary as the leading lady. Meanwhile, speculation surrounding his milestone 25th film suggests that newcomer Saatvika Veeravalli will star opposite him in a project directed by Clax.

news.title: NTR Graces Emotional Pre-Release Event for Don't Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: The grand pre-release event of Don't Trouble The Trouble brought together Rajamouli's family and NTR in an emotional reunion celebrating their long-standing journey. The film, which features Fahadh Faasil in the lead role and marks Karthik Karthikeya's debut as a producer, is directed by Shasank Yeleti and scheduled for an October 2 release.

news.title: Naga Chaitanya Locks in Clax for Milestone 25th Venture
news.summary: Following the success of Thandel and wrapping up Vrushakarma, Naga Chaitanya has officially chosen a musical love story for his landmark 25th film. The project will be a collaborative production between Geetha Arts, Annapurna Studios, and Bunny Vas, directed by Clax with newcomer Sathvika Veeravalli as the female lead.

news.title: Trivikram Clarifies Title Status for Upcoming Project with NTR
news.summary: Director Trivikram has confirmed that the complete script for his upcoming collaboration with actor NTR is fully prepared. However, during a promotional interview, he noted that the team has not yet locked an official title for the film, despite widespread speculation.

news.title: Makers Respond to Criticism Over Dialogue in Nani's The Paradise
news.summary: Director Srikanth Odela and actor Nani have addressed the negative reactions surrounding a controversial mother-daughter dialogue in their recent release, The Paradise. While Odela explained that the line stemmed from a mother's newfound awe at her daughter's talent, Nani acknowledged that a weaker setup diminished the intended impact for viewers.

news.title: Fresh Details Emerge Regarding NTR and Trivikram's Mythological Venture
news.summary: Director Trivikram Srinivas has shared that his upcoming mythological project with NTR has its script ready and is scheduled to go on floors in 2027. Currently, the filmmaker is gearing up for the release of his directorial Aadarsha Kutumbam, while NTR remains occupied with his film Dragon under Prashanth Neel's direction.

news.title: Melodic Title Track Released for Roshan and Preity Mukhundhan's Emo Emo Idi
news.summary: The makers of Emo Emo Idi have unveiled the film's title track, showcasing the fresh romantic pairing of Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundhan. Composed by Hesham Abdul Wahab and directed by Dr. Sailesh Kolanu, the breezy romantic number features picturesque snow-capped visuals and is scheduled to hit theaters on October 30, 2026.

news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Realities as Streaming Platforms Tighten Budgets
news.summary: Streaming services have cut back on massive acquisition spending, leaving medium-range movies and large-scale blockbusters facing strict financial limits. Producers are finding that expected digital payouts no longer match platform offers, forcing the industry to reconsider budget constraints. Consequently, filmmakers may soon need to rely heavily on box-office collections for revenue recovery.

news.title: Satyadev's Samavarthi Teaser Crosses Major Digital Milestone
news.summary: The promotional teaser for Satyadev's upcoming ecological action thriller Samavarthi has successfully surpassed one crore digital views. Directed by Ajay Nag V, the multilingual project deals with forest protection, wildlife, and tribal struggles against a rugged backdrop. The film features an ensemble cast and is lined up for a theatrical rollout later this year.

news.title: Satyadev's Ecological Action Thriller Samavarthi Generates Strong Pre-Release Buzz
news.summary: Actor Satyadev is starring in the forest-based action thriller Samavarthi, directed by Ajay Nag V. The film's teaser has surpassed one crore digital views, boosting business enquiries and anticipation. Produced by Rudra Pictures and Panchabhuta Productions, the project is slated for a multi-language release later this year.

news.title: Samavarthi Teaser Captures Audience Attention and Drives Market Interest
news.summary: The promotional teaser for Satyadev's upcoming film Samavarthi has successfully drawn viewer engagement and elevated commercial buzz. The ecological action drama highlights rugged forest visuals and intense survival themes. Industry attention has notably increased following the digital release of the promotional footage.

news.title: Diverse Lineup of Telugu and Dubbed Titles Head to OTT Platforms This Week
news.summary: Major streaming services are rolling out a fresh selection of movies and series between September 28 and October 4, 2026. The weekly lineup features regional titles like Romanchakam alongside dubbed versions of popular national and international projects. Viewers can access these new digital releases across platforms like Netflix and JioHotstar.

news.title: Teja Sajja to Lead Prime Video's Upcoming Telugu Reality Series The Traitors
news.summary: Actor Teja Sajja is stepping in as the host for Prime Video's global reality competition format, The Traitors Telugu. Set to premiere globally on October 15, the 10-episode show features 20 participants navigating a game of deception and strategy. Produced by SOL Productions, the series will stream weekly in Telugu with English subtitles.

news.title: Yogi Babu and Satya Pair Up for a Comedy Project
news.summary: Tamil comedian Yogi Babu and Telugu actor Satya are collaborating for the first time in a full-length comedy flick directed by Pawan Basamsetti. The makers dropped an entertaining promotional glimpse parodying famous announcements by Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan. The film features a prominent ensemble cast from both industries and has commenced its regular shooting schedule.

news.title: Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundan Romance in New Musical Single
news.summary: Director Sailesh Kolanu is steering away from thrillers to helm a romantic comedy titled Emo Emo Idi, starring Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundan. The team has rolled out the movie's first single, showcasing scenic snow-covered backdrops and the lead pair's sparkling chemistry. Set for an October 30 release, the track features vocals by Karthik and Ramya Behara with composition by Hesham Abdul Wahab.

news.title: Faria Abdullah Expresses Ambition to Direct Films
news.summary: Versatile performer Faria Abdullah, known for her diverse roles and special appearances in Tollywood, is eyeing a transition behind the camera. The actress revealed that she is actively crafting a script for her directorial debut. While she is taking her time to polish the writing before approaching producers, directing remains a major career goal.

news.title: Nagarjuna Shelves Proposed Rural Project with Kalyan Krishna
news.summary: King Nagarjuna reportedly set aside plans for his 100th film with director Kalyan Krishna Kurasala after his sons, Naga Chaitanya and Akhil, expressed reservations about the rural entertainer script. Following their feedback, Nagarjuna moved forward and chose Ra Karthik's film, titled King 100, as his landmark project with a Christmas release window. Meanwhile, Naga Chaitanya is wrapping up Vrushakarma and Akhil is yet to finalize his upcoming venture.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Wrap-Up on Varanasi Leaves Fans Guessing About His Next Move
news.summary: Mahesh Babu has wrapped up shooting his portions for Varanasi, leaving him with only dubbing and promotional duties ahead. Speculation has swirled regarding potential collaborations with directors like Sandeep Reddy Vanga, Buchi Babu Sana, and Sanjay Leela Bhansali. However, clearer updates on his upcoming projects are not expected until early 2027.

news.title: Prabhas Lineup Sparks Curiosity: Will Spirit Hit Screens Before Fauzi?
news.summary: Prabhas has opted out of Fauzi's original December 2026 release date to ensure uncompromised quality during post-production. Meanwhile, Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit remains tentatively slated for March 2027. This scheduling shift has sparked industry discussions that Spirit might ultimately arrive in theaters ahead of Fauzi.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Strong Weekday Footfall Across Major Centres
news.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's mass entertainer The Paradise has proven its box office pull extends well beyond the opening weekend. The movie recorded strong ticket sales and healthy theatrical occupancies across Hyderabad, the Nizam region, and Andhra Pradesh on Monday. The film's steady weekday performance has generated positive momentum for its ongoing theatrical run.

news.title: Casting Buzz Surrounds Nani's Upcoming Project With Sujeeth
news.summary: Following his work on The Paradise, actor Nani is set to collaborate with director Sujeeth for an action drama titled Bloody Romeo. Social media is currently abuzz with reports that Meenakshi Chaudhary is being considered for the female lead, though nothing has been officially confirmed. Meanwhile, enthusiastic fans have also voiced preferences for other actors like Bhagyashri Borse, Mamitha Baiju, and Wamiqa Gabbi.

news.title: Speculation Grows Over Dulquer Salmaan's Character Arc in Kalki 2
news.summary: With Nag Ashwin's epic sci-fi sequel Kalki 2 gearing up for its upcoming shooting schedule, fans are wondering if Dulquer Salmaan will reprise his role as Captain. Although the director noted that no new cast members are being added, previous comments about expanding the character's backstory have fueled speculation. The film will continue the narrative of the original blockbuster alongside returning stars Prabhas, Amitabh Bachchan, and Kamal Haasan.

news.title: Nani Seeks Blessings at Medaram Temple Following Box Office Success
news.summary: Actor Nani and members of his team recently traveled to the Medaram Sammakka-Saralamma shrine in Telangana to express gratitude for the strong theatrical run of The Paradise. Welcomed warmly by temple authorities, the actor offered traditional prayers and presented jaggery equivalent to his body weight to the deities. Visuals of the star surrounded by cheering fans at the holy site have since gone viral across social media platforms.

news.title: Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundhan light up the screen in Emo Emo Idi title track
news.summary: The creators of Emo Emo Idi have unveiled the official title track, highlighting a soothing melody composed by Hesham Abdul Wahab. The romantic number features lead actors Roshan Meka and Preity Mukhundhan against snow-capped mountain backdrops. Helmed by director Dr. Sailesh Kolanu, the movie is jointly backed by Sithara Entertainments and Fortune Four Cinemas.

news.title: Rajinikanth's action sequel Jailer 2 locks its theatrical trailer premiere
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's highly anticipated action sequel Jailer 2 has officially scheduled its theatrical trailer release for October 5. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the movie is set to arrive in cinemas on October 15 for the Dussehra festival. The star-studded project features music by Anirudh Ravichander alongside an extensive ensemble cast and special cameo appearances.

news.title: How a moment during Sita Ramam landed Rashmika Mandanna her role in Mysaa
news.summary: Director Rawindra Pulle revealed that witnessing Rashmika Mandanna's intense expressions while working together on Sita Ramam inspired him to cast her in Mysaa. Slated for a November 2026 release, the period action drama focuses on the Gond tribe. Rashmika dedicated herself fully to the project, undergoing specialized martial arts training abroad for demanding action sequences.
